{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Removes Boost.Test dependency and build workarounds from CMake, depends, vcpkg, and Guix build scripts.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Simplifies the build system and packaging by dropping Boost.Test dependency workarounds across Guix, vcpkg, and CMake. Eliminating external build dependencies and associated signal stack workarounds reduces maintenance overhead without affecting production binaries."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/ipc/test/ipc_tests.cpp are mechanical test runner include updates following from the framework change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": ""
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp are mechanical include updates for the new test runner.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": ""
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Introduces a custom in-tree test framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp} and replaces the Boost.Test runner across the entire unit test suite.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Replacing Boost.Test with an in-tree runner achieves a long-standing developer objective (#8670, RFC #34666) that substantially improves test diagnostics and infrastructure flexibility. The new framework introduces expression decomposition to expose operand values on assertion failure and removes barriers to future concurrency improvements to speed up CI runs."
    },

      "name": "tools",
